comment: Inputs for generate.py: the source and version of every table. A released Unicode Character Database version never changes, so each Unicode file is named by its version. The Unicode files come from the Unicode Consortium's unicodetools repository, which publishes the Unicode Character Database of every released version (the same files as https://www.unicode.org/Public/). The RFC 3454 text comes from the GNU Libidn copy of the RFC; generate.py --crosscheck compares every table read from it with CPython's stringprep module, generated from CPython's own copy of the RFC.

3.2.0.use: RFC 3491 Nameprep: RFC 3454 section 4 fixes Unicode 3.2 for stringprep NFKC

18.0.0.use: RFC 3987 section 5.3.2.2 character normalization (NFC): the latest released Unicode version
